title: Back-End Isolated DE Optimization on 24-Layer Dichroic Stack
scientific_hypothesis: The performance margin gained in iteration_07 (0.601 to 0.691) is primarily attributable to back-end layer phase adjustments; freezing layers 0-11 and optimizing only layers 12-23 should recover most of the achievable target score while reducing search dimensionality.
design_principle: Asymmetrical optimization isolates contribution of back-end layers to dual-band spectral separation; DE optimizer with population=50, F=0.8, CR=0.9 provides global search capability for the 12 free variables.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: layers 0-11 frozen at iteration_07 best candidate values
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence preserved for deposition simplicity
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for coherent plane-wave multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack theory for broadband reflectors
Gradient-based and evolutionary optimization for thin-film design
expected_advantages: Reduced search dimensionality (12 vs 24 variables) accelerates convergence
Isolates back-end layer contribution to spectral performance
Tests whether front-end layers are already near-optimal
known_risks: Freezing front layers may prevent discovery of better global solutions
DE may stagnate if back-end layers have limited influence on target bands
Performance may drop significantly if front-back coupling is strong
execution_request_english: Execute TMM optimization for a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dichroic stack on fused silica substrate under normal incidence. Initialize all 24 layer thicknesses to iteration_07 best candidate values: [77.71, 177.76, 65.96, 87.63, 94.31, 100.73, 236.50, 85.64, 126.52, 87.80, 60.22, 87.68, 209.35, 88.73, 63.43, 79.31, 63.65, 84.16, 163.16, 212.54, 63.22, 82.93, 177.90, 68.43] nm. Freeze layers 0-11 at these values. Apply Differential Evolution optimizer (population=50, F=0.8, CR=0.9, max_generations=200) exclusively to layers 12-23 with bounds 50-280 nm. Evaluate coherent TMM at normal incidence for unpolarized light. Compute target score as weighted mean of (transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band) and (reflectance in 400-700 nm band) with equal weights. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, run_status, and final thicknesses_nm for all 24 layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Follows feedback directive to test asymmetrical optimization: freeze front 12 layers, optimize back 12 layers with DE to isolate whether performance margin stems from back-end phase adjustments.
